presentation.tagline: Several Claude Code accounts, one conversation.
presentation.description: Tracks each Claude Code account's 5-hour and weekly usage and hands your conversation to the next account when one hits its limit, so you never start over.

features.title: One conversation
features.description: When an account hits its limit, Baton resumes the same conversation on the next one.

features.title: Usage at a glance
features.description: Every account's 5-hour and weekly use, in a full-screen menu and in the Claude Code status line.

features.title: Your accounts stay yours
features.description: Baton never reads a credential and never touches your default Claude Code account.
